questions.question: Indonesia signed a new trade deal with which international block that will eliminate tariffs on 98.5% of incoming goods?
questions.explanation: The fresh economic agreements between Indonesia and the European Union will scrap nearly all tariffs on EU exports.
questions.context: Indonesia–European Union trade relations: Indonesia and the European Union sign trade and investment agreements that will lift 98.5% of tariffs on EU goods.

questions.question: Dozens of garment factories in Bangladesh were forced to close and declare holidays following worker protests over which issue?
questions.explanation: The industrial closures in Savar and Ashulia occurred as garment workers organized sit-ins demanding higher minimum wages.
questions.context: 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests: At least 80 garment factories in Savar and Ashulia, Bangladesh, declare general holidays after workers stage sit-ins and work stoppages over minimum wage demands, while police announce that 96 people, including five labour leaders, have been arrested in connection with the 4 November clashes on the Dhaka–Aricha Highway.

questions.question: The European Space Agency announced that the BepiColombo probe successfully entered into orbit around which planet?
questions.explanation: BepiColombo has reached its final destination and successfully inserted itself into orbit around Mercury.
questions.context: Exploration of Mercury: The European Space Agency announces that the BepiColombo spacecraft inserted itself into orbit around Mercury.

questions.story: Middle Eastern crisis > Gaza war > Gaza genocide, Gaza humanitarian crisis
questions.question: Aid transport was targeted during recent violence in Gaza City according to reports from which local service?
questions.explanation: Gaza's civil defence agency reported casualties following a drone strike on a vehicle carrying foodstuffs.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > Gaza war > Gaza genocide, Gaza humanitarian crisis: Gaza's civil defence agency reports four people killed by Israeli fire, including three in a drone strike on a food-carrying vehicle in Gaza City and one by gunfire in Jabalia. Israel says it targeted operatives.

questions.question: Laid-off clothing factory workers blocked roads in Bangladesh's Narayanganj District due to disputes regarding what issue?
questions.explanation: Former factory staff blocked traffic by burning tyres and cutting down trees in protest over back pay.
questions.context: 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests: Laid-off garment workers in Rupganj, Narayanganj District, block roads by felling trees and burning tires over unpaid wages.
